name: ShieldClimb – Auto Complete Orders for WooCommerce
author: ShieldClimb

sections.description:
Auto Complete Orders for WooCommerce after payment is the ultimate solution for store owners looking to streamline order fulfillment for downloadable and virtual products.

This lightweight, fast, and efficient plugin automatically completes orders once payment is confirmed, ensuring that your customers gain immediate access to their purchases without manual intervention.

Compatible with all major payment gateways such as PayPal, Stripe, and others, this plugin seamlessly integrates into your WooCommerce store, saving you time and effort while enhancing the customer experience.

With no complicated setup required, it’s a simple, no-fuss tool that optimizes your store’s order processing workflow.

Perfect for businesses focused on digital goods, this plugin ensures that customers receive their products without unnecessary delays.

See more in documentation via this website.

sections.installation:
1. Download our plugin from https://shieldclimb.com/free-woocommerce-plugins/auto-complete-orders/
  2. At your WordPress admin, Go to Plugins > Add New Plugin > Upload Plugin > Choose File (Choose the file you downloaded just now) > Click Install
  3. Click Activate
  4. Done! It starts working immediately. No setup needed.

sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with both downloadable and virtual products?

Yes, it works seamlessly with both types of products. If your products are digital, they’ll be available immediately after payment.

Will this plugin work with physical products as well?

No, this plugin is specifically designed for downloadable and virtual products. For physical products, WooCommerce’s default order process applies.

What happens if an order is marked as “on-hold” or “failed”?

This plugin only works for orders that are marked as “processing” status (By default, WooCommerce can leave orders with downloadable or virtual products in “processing” status until manual action is taken). If an order is marked as “on-hold” or “failed,” it will not be automatically completed. The order must first transition to the “processing” status after a successful payment before the plugin can automatically complete it. Once the order is in “processing” status, the plugin will complete the order, granting customers immediate access to their downloadable or virtual products.

Does this plugin support multi-currency stores?

Yes, the plugin supports multi-currency stores as long as the payment gateway used supports multiple currencies.
